title: TENT5C functions as a corepressor in the ligand-bound glucocorticoid receptor and estrogen receptor alpha complexes.
authors: Li, Yin; Perera, Lalith; He, Rebecca S; Baptissart, Marine; Petrovich, Robert M; Morgan, Marcos
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TENT5C作为核受体辅阻遏物调控GR/ERα复合物，含MD模拟蛋白-DNA相关互作，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Terminal nucleotidyltransferase 5C (TENT5C) is a noncanonical poly(A) polymerase that promotes cancer suppression. TENT5C has been proposed to mediate the susceptibility of multiple myeloma to treatment with dexamethasone, a steroid hormone analog that binds to the glucocorticoid receptor (GR). However, the relationship between TENT5C and nuclear receptor (NR) signaling remains unclear. In this study, we investigate the regulatory role of TENT5C in the GR and estrogen receptor alpha (ERalpha) ligand complexes. We find that TENT5C acts as a corepressor of both GR and ERalpha. Molecular dynamics simulations indicate that the third TENT5C LXXLL motif directly interacts with ERalpha, but not GR. The physical interaction of TENT5C and ERalpha is supported by co-immunoprecipitation assays. Reporter assays show that mutations to the third TENT5C LXXLL motif disrupt TENT5C-mediated repression of ERalpha but do not affect the repression of the GR complex. In addition, the disruption of TENT5C poly(A) polymerase activity does not appear to affect TENT5C repression of ERalpha in the cell lines studied. Taken together, our findings highlight a role of TENT5C as an NR corepressor, differentially modulating GR- and ERalpha-induced transcriptional activity.
abstract_zh: 末端核苷酸转移酶5C（TENT5C）是一种非经典poly(A)聚合酶，可促进癌症抑制。TENT5C被认为介导多发性骨髓瘤对地塞米松（一种与糖皮质激素受体（GR）结合的类固醇激素类似物）治疗的敏感性。然而，TENT5C与核受体（NR）信号传导之间的关系仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了TENT5C在GR和雌激素受体α（ERalpha）配体复合物中的调控作用。我们发现TENT5C作为GR和ERalpha的共抑制因子。分子动力学模拟表明，TENT5C的第三个LXXLL基序直接与ERalpha相互作用，但不与GR相互作用。TENT5C与ERalpha的物理相互作用通过共免疫沉淀实验得到支持。报告基因实验显示，TENT5C第三个LXXLL基序的突变破坏了TENT5C介导的ERalpha抑制，但不影响GR复合物的抑制。此外，在所研究的细胞系中，TENT5C poly(A)聚合酶活性的破坏似乎不影响TENT5C对ERalpha的抑制。综上所述，我们的发现突显了TENT5C作为NR共抑制因子的作用，差异性地调节GR和ERalpha诱导的转录活性。
